companyFieldUpdates.description: Primergy develops, finances, owns and operates utility-scale solar and battery-storage projects across North America. Quinbrook launched the platform in 2020 and continues to identify it as a 100%-owned portfolio company. Primergy's projects include Ash Creek Solar, a 408 MWac operating solar facility in Hill County, Texas that Primergy acquired in 2021, financed in 2024 under a long-term Microsoft PPA and brought into commercial operation on July 17, 2025. Ash Creek Solar LLC and the legacy Sam Switch Solar name are project/SPV identities within Primergy and are not separate manager-level portfolio companies. No later Primergy sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through September 1, 2026.

set.event: Primergy announced commercial operation of the 408 MWac Ash Creek Solar project in Texas.

milestoneTransfers.event: Primergy acquired the Ash Creek project from Orion Renewable Energy Group; the exact closing date was not publicly disclosed.
Primergy signed a long-term power purchase agreement with Microsoft for the Ash Creek project.
Primergy closed $588 million of project financing and a long-term power purchase agreement with Microsoft for Ash Creek.
Primergy secured $350 million of tax-equity financing for Ash Creek; the investor positions are financing rather than sponsor ownership.
